WHAT IS ZYLON?

A complete private AI infrastructure, entirely under your control

Zylon, the only truly private AI infrastructure for regulated industries

What is Zylon? Zylon is an enterprise AI infrastructure delivering private generative AI and on-premise AI software for regulated industries, enabling secure deployment inside enterprise infrastructure without external cloud dependencies.

100% On-Premise

Runs in your data center or private cloud, air-gapped. Your data never touches external servers.

Ready in Days, Not Months

Single-command deployment. Production-ready in under one week. No lengthy integration projects.

Unlimited, Fixed Cost

No per-token pricing. No usage limits. One platform, fixed cost, full value.

Full Stack Control

Not a wrapper—a complete AI infrastructure. LLMs, vector search, ingestion, API Gateway, and workspace included.
